correctness.rationale: For one fusion subspace H with weight 2 and K=I, the synthesis operator is 2I, its reduced factorization solution is I/2, and theta=I/4 satisfies the paper's weighted l2-resolution definition. The theorem would require 1/4 <= 1/16 on every nonzero vector. The repaired inequalities follow by applying synthesis to the correctly weighted vector {omega_i theta_i f} and using orthogonality to N(T_W).
